understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece on a goal tile marked +; the level is won only when all goals are occupied simultaneously.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces can be selected and moved by clicking positions or using directional moves. Movement is constrained by walls and obstacles; blocked moves do nothing but consume a step. Pieces may need to be pushed or navigated around obstacles, and clicking can reposition the selected piece when the destination is reachable.
